name: ISR to CIF
source: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim + Overpass API (ODbL), queried 2026-09-10; entrances = OSM entrance nodes, intersections = OSM street-intersection/crossing nodes, WP5 interpolated mid-block; not yet walked/GPS-verified

waypoints.say: Leaving ISR. Follow the covered walk south, then the path west and down to the Illinois Street sidewalk.
Illinois Street sidewalk. Turn right and walk west. Goodwin Avenue is about 175 meters ahead.
Goodwin Avenue. Intersection. Turn right to face north and stay on this side. No crossing needed. Listen for traffic.
Green Street. Crossing. Signalized, push button. Listen for traffic, then cross and continue north.
Halfway up Goodwin. Keep going north. Springfield Avenue is about 125 meters ahead.
Springfield Avenue. Crossing Goodwin. Signalized, push button. Listen for traffic, cross to the west side, then turn left and walk west.
Mathews Avenue. Crossing. Listen for traffic, then cross and continue west. CIF is about 150 meters ahead.
CIF is ahead on your left. Turn left and follow the path south-west to the east entrance.
You have arrived at the Campus Instructional Facility, east entrance.
